class.name: LevelStreamer3D
class.brief_description: Streams the [LevelStreamCell3D] nodes below it in and out around a target.
class.description: Each [LevelStreamCell3D] below this node names an ordinary scene file. While the target (see [member target_path]) is within a cell's [member LevelStreamCell3D.preload_distance], the streamer loads the cell's scene in the background with [method ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request], instantiates it on a worker thread and adds it as the cell's child. When the target is farther than [member LevelStreamCell3D.unload_distance], the content is saved (see below), removed and freed. The gap between the two distances keeps a cell at its boundary from loading and unloading over and over. Work on the main thread is bounded: at most [member max_loading] scenes load at a time, and at most [member max_activations_per_frame] cells are added and removed per frame, nearest first. Requests are idempotent; a scene that arrives after the target turned back is dropped. A scene that fails to load emits [signal cell_failed] and is tried again after [member retry_delay]. A cell is [constant CELL_ACTIVE] once its content is in the tree and [constant CELL_READY] [member ready_physics_frames] physics frames later, when its collision shapes and navigation regions are registered. [method is_position_ready] tells whether the target can safely be at a point. For a teleport, call [method prefetch_position] with the destination, wait for [signal destination_ready], move the target and call [method clear_prefetch]. [b]Keeping state:[/b] nodes of a cell's scene in the [code]level_stream_persistent[/code] group can define [code]_save_stream_state() -> Variant[/code] and [code]_load_stream_state(state: Variant)[/code]. The first is called when the cell unloads, the second when it loads again, before the node enters the tree (so [method Node._ready] sees the restored state). The state is keyed by cell ID and node path; [method get_cell_state_data] and [method set_cell_state_data] read and write it for save games. In the editor every cell's scene is shown (see [member preview_in_editor]); the preview is never saved into the level. On export, the cells' scenes are added to presets that export only selected scenes and their dependencies. A project without a streamer pays nothing per frame.

method.name: clear_prefetch
method.description: Releases the cells kept loaded by [method prefetch_position]; they then load and unload by distance again.

method.name: get_cell
method.description: Returns the cell with the ID [param cell_id], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_cell_content
method.description: Returns the root of the cell's instantiated scene while the cell is active or ready, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_cell_ids
method.description: Returns the IDs of all streamed cells, in tree order.

method.name: get_cell_state
method.description: Returns the cell's [enum CellState]. Unknown IDs return [constant CELL_UNLOADED].

method.name: get_cell_state_data
method.description: Returns the saved state of the cell's persistent nodes, keyed by node path relative to the cell's content. For an active cell, the current state.

method.name: get_cells_at
method.description: Returns the IDs of the cells whose bounds contain [param global_point].

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns counters for profiling: [code]cells[/code], the number of cells in each state ([code]unloaded[/code], [code]loading[/code], [code]instantiating[/code], [code skip-lint]active[/code], [code]ready[/code], [code]failed[/code]), and the totals [code]requests[/code], [code]activations[/code], [code]unloads[/code], [code]failures[/code] and [code]stale[/code] (loaded scenes dropped because the target turned back), [code]last_activation_usec[/code] and [code]max_activation_usec[/code] (main thread time to add a cell's content), [code]last_ready_delay_usec[/code] and [code]max_ready_delay_usec[/code] (from load request to ready).

method.name: is_cell_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the cell is [constant CELL_READY].

method.name: is_position_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if every cell containing [param global_point] is ready. A point outside all cells is ready.

method.name: prefetch_position
method.description: Loads the cells containing [param global_point] and their neighbors whatever their distance, and keeps them loaded until [method clear_prefetch]. [signal destination_ready] is emitted when all of them are ready. Replaces the previous prefetch.

method.name: set_cell_state_data
method.description: Replaces the saved state of the cell's persistent nodes (see [method get_cell_state_data]). If the cell is active, its nodes receive it at once.

method.name: update_now
method.description: Runs one streaming update immediately instead of waiting for the next frame.

members.member: If [code]false[/code], nothing is loaded or unloaded, and the streamer does no work per frame.
The most cells added to the tree per frame, and the most removed. Lower values spread the main thread cost of a boundary over more frames.
The most cell scenes loading in the background at once.
If [code]true[/code], the editor shows every cell's scene, so a level can be laid out. The preview is not saved.
The physics frames between a cell's content entering the tree and the cell becoming [constant CELL_READY]. Bodies join the physics space and navigation regions sync on the physics step.
Seconds before a cell whose scene failed to load is tried again.
The [Node3D] cells stream around. If empty, the viewport's current [Camera3D].

If [code]true[/code], cell scenes are instantiated on a worker thread, and only added to the tree on the main thread. Disable it if scripts in the cell scenes access the scene tree in [method Object._init].

signal.name: cell_activated
signal.description: Emitted after the cell's [param content] was added to the tree.

signal.name: cell_activating
signal.description: Emitted before the cell's [param content] is added to the tree, after its saved state was restored.

signal.name: cell_failed
signal.description: Emitted when the cell's scene at [param path] could not be loaded or instantiated. It is retried after [member retry_delay].

signal.name: cell_ready
signal.description: Emitted when the cell becomes [constant CELL_READY].

signal.name: cell_unloaded
signal.description: Emitted after the cell's content was removed from the tree.

signal.name: cell_unloading
signal.description: Emitted before the cell's [param content] is saved and removed from the tree.

signal.name: destination_ready
signal.description: Emitted when all cells loaded by [method prefetch_position] for [param global_point] are ready.

constants.constant: The scene is loading in the background.
The scene is loaded and being instantiated, or waits for its turn to be added to the tree.
The content is in the tree; its collision and navigation may not be registered yet.
The content has been in the tree for [member ready_physics_frames] physics frames: safe to enter.
The scene failed to load; it is tried again after [member retry_delay].
